narrationTexts: Two real bugs, both from bump. Fix both.
finalText:
Build green. Exit 0, 0 errors.

**Two real bugs, both from bump:**
- `src/core/options.js:6` — option renamed `retries` to `retryCount`; call site never updated, so `options.retries.toFixed()` threw. Now reads `retryCount ?? retries ?? 0`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined`, old one gave `false`. Strict check threw on `{}`. Now `undefined`/`null` = disabled; non-boolean still throws.

Second bug was hidden behind first — only surfaced after fixing options.

**8 warnings remain, all noise.** Emitted unconditionally by `build.js` (hardcoded `DEPRECATIONS` array plus 3 `W####` lines at fixed module counts). They point at files that don't exist in this tree (`src/legacy/adapter.js`, `src/utils/format.js`, `src/core/graph.js`). Nothing to fix in code — silencing them means editing the bundler's own output. Say word if want that.
